Type: storage bench with lift-up seat
Use: seating plus storage for towels, laundry or shoes; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, traditional, coastal
Materials: white painted wood with beadboard panels, square wooden legs
Colors: soft white
Shape: boxy chest on four short square legs, flat overhanging lid, vertical grooved beadboard panels on the front and sides, framed edges, compact and sturdy
Feel: fresh, homely, clean, calm
Goes with: white tiles, light wood, pale blue or grey tones; cottage, coastal or farmhouse bathrooms and entryways

product.name: SILVERN
product.description: There's plenty of room inside the bench to store and organise your towels and other bathroom things.
